topic: Purpose of various forms used in aircraft / equipment servicing: (its importance, calculation & recording of life, action in case of loss and method of raising log card)
syllabus_extract: Purpose of various forms used in aircraft / equipment servicing: (its importance, calculation & recording of life, action in case of loss and method of raising log card), A-701, A -701B, A-703, A-704, A-705, A-706, A-720, A-2, A-9, A-10, A-11, A-20 (modified), A- 21 (latest version), A-25, A-53.
specific_objectives: 1.1.2.1 Trainee will be able to explain the documentation and various other forms used in naval aircraft.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of Log Card (A-21) and Service Life calculation sheets; Instructor supervision on form identification and data entry accuracy.
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of aircraft maintenance documentation?
Why is recording service life critical for airworthiness?
What immediate action is required if a log card is lost?

development.content:
Importance of maintenance forms
Overview of A-701 and A-701B
Purpose of A-703 and A-704
Role of A-705 and A-706
Function of A-720

Calculation and recording of life
Forms A-2, A-9, A-10, A-11
Modified A-20 and latest A-21
Forms A-25 and A-53 usage
Action in case of loss

Method of raising log card
Procedure for new entry
Verification steps
Filing and archiving
Cross-referencing requirements

summary_questions: Explain the specific role of Form A-21 in the latest version.
Describe the procedure to follow if a service life calculation is found to be incorrect.
How does the loss of a log card impact the aircraft's operational status?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief summary of the method for raising a log card as outlined in the syllabus, to be discussed in the next lesson on Modification (LP 09).

pft_rows.syllabus: Modification: Definition and procedure (configuration control committee, LMC). Classification, promulgation and embodiment of modification, accounting of Mod kit, reports and returns, naval service modification (NSM), Modification SOP and concession.
